title: Welcome to today's session
description: Take a few minutes to share where you are starting from, then check what you have learned with a short quiz. You can do either part in any order.
privacyMessage: Your answers stay in this browser tab only. They are not saved, not sent anywhere, and not linked to you. Refreshing or closing the page clears them.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: A few warm-up questions to help us start the session together. There are no right or wrong answers.
introduction.completionMessage: You are ready for the session. Keep your answers in mind; we will come back to them during the day.

questions.text: Which apps do you use most days?
How confident do you feel using AI assistants at work today?
Have you tried Copilot before this session?
In one word or a short phrase, how do you feel about AI at work?
questions.answerGuidance: A single word or a few words is enough.

questions.text: What would make today's session worthwhile for you?
questions.answerGuidance: Write a sentence or two. A longer answer is welcome but not needed.
questions.imageAlt: A path with three markers labelled start, practise and apply.

questions.text: Turn to the person next to you and share one task you would like to spend less time on.
This question is hidden because active is false.

quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.description: Check your understanding. You can take a hint, and you see an explanation after each answer.

feedback.message: Excellent work. You have a strong grasp of today's topics.
Good progress. Review the explanations below to strengthen the remaining areas.
A good start. Go through the explanations below and try again whenever you are ready.

questions.text: What does it mean when Copilot "grounds" a response?

options.label: It uses your work content and context to make the answer relevant
It saves the response to OneDrive
It shortens the response to one paragraph
It translates the response into your language

questions.explanation: Grounding adds relevant information from sources you can access, such as emails, files and meetings, so the answer fits your situation.
questions.hint: Think about where the extra information comes from.

questions.text: Which elements help make a clear prompt?

options.label: The goal you want to achieve

questions.explanation: A clear prompt states the goal, gives context, and points to the sources to use. Never include passwords or other secrets in a prompt.

questions.text: Copilot can only use content that you already have permission to access.
questions.explanation: Copilot respects existing permissions. It does not give you access to files or messages you could not open yourself.

questions.text: In one word: what should you always do with an AI-generated draft before you send it?
questions.explanation: Always review the draft. You are responsible for the accuracy and tone of what you send.

questions.text: What is the best next step?
questions.supportingText: You missed the first 20 minutes of a Teams meeting that is being transcribed. You want to catch up without interrupting the discussion.

options.label: Ask Copilot in the meeting to summarise what has been discussed so far
Ask the organiser to repeat the first part of the meeting
Wait until the recording is available next week

questions.explanation: Copilot in Teams can summarise the discussion so far from the transcript, so you can catch up straight away without interrupting.
questions.hint: Which option lets you catch up right now, on your own?
